articles.headline: Portugal coach announces final 26-man World Cup squad
articles.description: The Portugal manager confirmed the group for the World Cup 2026 with no major surprises.

articles.headline: Portugal win pre-tournament friendly to build momentum
articles.description: Portugal secured a comfortable victory in their final warm-up match before WC2026.

articles.headline: Portugal captain backs young squad to go far at World Cup 2026
articles.description: The Portugal skipper expressed confidence in the blend of experience and youth in the squad.
